name: io.github.Servosity/vsphere-mcp
title: VMware vSphere MCP
description: Read-only vCenter inventory for migration planning: blockers, snapshots, per-core licence exposure

environmentVariables.name: VSPHERE_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: vCenter SSO user, for example readonly@vsphere.local. A Read-Only role is enough.

environmentVariables.name: VSPHERE_TLS_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only for a self-signed vCenter certificate: its SHA-256 fingerprint (comma-separate several).

environmentVariables.name: VSPHERE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to vCenter. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Binds the MCP server to one saved client profile. Leave blank for the default.

environmentVariables.name: VSPHERE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools. vCenter is only ever read; the tools that write this CLI's own files (learnings, playbooks, the local store, exports) act only with confirm set to true, and this switch hides them. Leave blank.

environmentVariables.name: VSPHERE_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to vCenter and nothing is written to the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: VSPHERE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
